banner: S-16003  -  Add Part Fee / Discount, opened from the PART ROW kebab   (build v3.8-1f5fb3c)

boxes.label: the gate: a QuickBooks Fee item must be mapped
the Taxable control - what a tax test would need

caption:
Both entry points the QA lead named were driven: the work-order kebab AND this one, the part row kebab
(Move | Add Part Fee / Discount). Both open this dialog with a working live preview, and both leave Add Fee
disabled behind the same banner. So the control is not missing - it is gated on a QuickBooks Fee item mapping,
and that mapping cannot be created here because no QuickBooks company is attached to this org.

banner: S-16001  -  Parts > Returns > Receive Credit > "Process Return"   -   this is a VENDOR credit

boxes.label: Subtotal is the part COST ($10.00), not its $80.00 sell price

caption:
The credit for a returned part, reached the way the QA lead described. It is priced at the part COST and its
Tax is pre-filled at 5% of that cost from the workplace tax rate - NOT the location sales-tax model, which is
9.75% here, and not the frozen invoice tax. It read identically under both rounding modes, and posting it left
the customer invoice untouched. Note both boxed fields carry the SAME data-test-id="input_base".
